title: The Most Expensive Model
question: Can Mr. Frith buy the television on instalments? How does it work?

meanings.usage: 常与can/can't连用，表示是否有足够的钱
购物时先支付的一部分钱
表示某物有相应的价值

examples.en: Can we buy it on instalments?
examples.zh: 我们可以分期付款购买吗？

examples.en: He paid for his car on instalments.
examples.zh: 他以分期付款的方式买了车。

examples.en: You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds.
examples.zh: 你可以支付三十英镑订金。

examples.en: We can't afford all that money.
examples.zh: 我们负担不起那么多钱。

sentences.en: But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.

sentences.en: Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!
sentences.zh: 有时候你以为自己是百万富翁！

sentences.en: Millionaires don't buy things on instalments!
sentences.zh: 百万富翁可不会分期付款买东西！

grammar.title: 形容词比较级和最高级
grammar.definition: 形容词有两种比较形式：比较级用于两者之间的比较，最高级用于三者或以上的比较
grammar.structure: 比较级：adj + -er / more + adj；最高级：the + adj + -est / the most + adj
grammar.usage: 用于比较物品的价格、质量等

examples.en: This model's less expensive than that one.
It's the most expensive model in the shop.
The other model's more expensive.

grammar.title: as...as 结构
grammar.definition: 表示两者在某方面相同或相等

examples.en: It's not as good as the expensive one.
He is as tall as his brother.

grammar.title: 特殊疑问句 How much
grammar.structure: How much + does/do + 主语 + cost?

examples.en: How much does it cost?
How much does this television cost?
How much does this watch cost?
How much does the computer cost?

examples.zh: 我们负担不起这么昂贵的假期。
